mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drop > 2% does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 5% YoY does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent labor market strength indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, especially during economic expansion regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase > 1% MoM does not correlate with subsequent consumer demand strength indicators during expansion regimes.
